input.summary: Select a Room with a lit Advance Tour shot, build its value during travel, and start it at the door. Start a compatible Room before the third Seance lock, then collect blue Jackpots, use Help for add-a-ball, and follow the red captive ball to the right-ramp Super Jackpot.

steps.text: Plunge the lit drop target for the most useful skill-shot award. Prefer Complete OPEN or Max Spirit Energy when available.
modeNotes: The skill-shot light cycles across the three center drop targets. The all-lit interval awards points instead of utility.

steps.text: Shoot a lit Advance Tour shot to choose its displayed Room. During travel, shoot dim-white shots to build the Room value or hold the action button to Run. At the door, shoot another lit Advance Tour shot to start the Room.

Clear the three inline drops and shoot the Seance Room to lock a ball. Repeat until three balls have been locked. When the captive ball is green, hit it to lower all three drops for the next Seance Room shot.
modeNotes: Seance Multiball can stack with most active Rooms and normal Thirteen mini-modes, but those features must start before Seance Multiball. Hungering Flame does not stack with it.

steps.text: Start a compatible Room before making the third Seance lock because a new Room cannot start after Seance Multiball begins. The third lock starts Multiball; shoot blue Jackpots and hit the Help target when add-a-ball is lit.
After enough blue jackpots, hit the red captive ball. Then shoot the right ramp behind the fallen tower for the Super Jackpot.
modeNotes: A Seance Super Jackpot qualifies a Memento. Mementos provide one-time or permanent game advantages.

steps.text: After multiball, complete the Room if its shots remain safe. Collect the cyan-lit Memento at the captive ball.

fallback.title: Wheelbarrow Ghost Multiball
fallback.when: Use this when the Seance inline drops or lock feed are dangerous.

steps.text: Spell OPEN at the inlanes.
Shoot a cyan ramp, then take the matching turntable shot to the Stairs to Nowhere.
On default settings, the first cyan turntable shot locks one ball and starts Wheelbarrow Ghost Multiball. Later starts require three completed hurry-ups.
Shoot the spinner to lower boiler pressure and red arrows to banish spirits.
Survive the countdown, collect the boiler jackpot, and shoot the front hall scoop to relight the spinner.

alternatives.title: North or South Conservatory
alternatives.when: Use this route when you have keys and want the newest Room progress instead of preparing Seance locks.

steps.text: Complete the upper-left key drop bank. At a Room choice, press the action button to spend a key on an adjacent locked Room, then shoot the Advance Tour arrow whose color matches the path toward a Conservatory.
During travel, build the Room value with dim-white shots or hold the action button to Run. At the door, shoot a lit Advance Tour shot to start the Room.
In South Conservatory: The Watching Glass, shoot the cyan good shots and avoid the moving orange shot that marks Elias.
modeNotes: Targets can remove cyan shots. A cyan shot restores them.
If Elias notices you, shoot the flashing right ramp before his countdown ends. Hit enough cyan shots to escape and complete the Room.

steps.text: In North Conservatory: What Lies Beneath, follow the single lit shot to draw three sigils.
modeNotes: The three sigils require two, three, then four progress shots.
Lit targets near the spinner can advance the sigil for reduced value. Finishing quickly converts the remaining time into completion points.

steps.text: Start a compatible Room.
Lock balls in the Seance Room and start Seance Multiball.
Collect blue jackpots, then hit the red captive ball.
Collect the right-ramp Super Jackpot and its Memento.

quickInfo.name: Conservatory Rooms
quickInfo.summary: Use keys to unlock adjacent Rooms and follow the color-coded Advance Tour path. South Conservatory plays The Watching Glass; North Conservatory plays What Lies Beneath.

quickInfo.name: Thirteens and Seance
quickInfo.summary: Normal Thirteen mini-modes can continue into Seance Multiball on the August 2026 code, but start them before the third Seance lock. This does not refer to the Thirteenths mini-wizard.

cautions.issue: The inline Seance drops can reject a direct shot.
cautions.response: Hit instrument targets or collect spirits until the captive ball turns green, then hit it to lower all three drops before shooting the Seance Room.

input.simpleOverview: Choose a Room at a lit Advance Tour shot, build its value at dim-white travel shots, then shoot lit Advance Tour at the door to start it. For the first Wheelbarrow Ghost Multiball, complete O-P-E-N, shoot either cyan ramp, then shoot its matching cyan turntable hall. For playfield X, use a ramp to light the spinner, fill more than half of the Spirit meter, hit the pulsing X target for 2x, and collect the multiplied bank at the right orbit after time expires.
input.overview: Winchester Mystery House alternates Room selection, travel, and the Room mode itself. Start a compatible Room before Seance Multiball because a new Room cannot start after the Multiball begins. For each of three locks, clear the inline drops and shoot the Seance Room; a green captive-ball hit lowers all three drops. The third lock starts Seance Multiball. Collect blue Jackpots, hit Help for add-a-ball, then hit the red captive ball and shoot the right ramp for the Super Jackpot.

content.summary: Use lit Advance Tour shots to choose and start a Room, complete O-P-E-N for Wheelbarrow Ghost Multiball, or fill the Spirit meter and hit the X target for playfield X.

steps.title: Start a Room
steps.text: At the Foyer, shoot any shot with a lit Advance Tour insert to choose its matching displayed Room. During travel, shoot dim-white shots to build the Room value or hold the action button to run. At Outside the Door, shoot another lit Advance Tour shot to start the Room.

steps.title: Start Wheelbarrow Ghost Multiball
steps.text: Complete O-P-E-N at the inlanes, then shoot either cyan ramp. Shoot the matching cyan turntable hall for the first lock; on default settings, that first lock starts Wheelbarrow Ghost Multiball.

steps.title: Start playfield X
steps.text: Shoot any ramp to light the spinner, then shoot the lit spinner until the Spirit meter is more than half full. Hit the pulsing X target for 2x; hit it again during 2x for 3x. When the timer ends, shoot the right orbit within 20 seconds to collect the multiplied bank.

quickInfo.name: Conservatory Rooms
quickInfo.summary: Use keys to unlock adjacent Rooms and follow the color-coded Advance Tour path. South Conservatory plays The Watching Glass; North Conservatory plays What Lies Beneath.

quickInfo.name: Thirteens and Seance
quickInfo.summary: Normal Thirteen mini-modes can continue into Seance Multiball on the August 2026 code, but start them before the third Seance lock. This does not refer to the Thirteenths mini-wizard.

fallback.title: Alternative route: ball-three Seance Multiball
fallback.when: Use this on default settings if Seance Multiball has not started before ball three.

steps.text: At the start of ball three, the Seance inline drops lower automatically. Shoot the open Seance Room once to start Seance Multiball.
